marketInfo.assetDescription:
Junior NUSD is a yield-bearing investment product that represents the junior risk tranche in Strata’s structure. It offers leveraged upside to sNUSD APY while simultaneously functioning as a liquid insurance pool for srNUSD. By underwriting sNUSD’s underperformance against the benchmark (Ethena sUSDe APY) and underlying strategy risks, jrNUSD earns a risk premium from the senior tranche, delivering potentially higher yield for risk-tolerant investors.

jrNUSD captures the residual yield after the senior tranche is paid and absorbs any shortfall when sNUSD APY falls below the guaranteed minimum yield for srNUSD, which is tied to the benchmark rate. It also provides first-loss protection to srNUSD in the event of NUSD insolvency. As a result, jrNUSD tends to outperform sNUSD in high-yield environments but may underperform when sNUSD APY falls below the benchmark rate.
marketInfo.riskInvolved:
• The pool will generate negative yield if a portion of the jrNUSD reserves is allocated to srNUSD to guarantee the srNUSD floor APY or in case of NUSD insolvency.

(From Underlying Protocol)
marketInfo.importantQuirks: • Instant withdrawal to sNUSD is subject to 0% to 0.2% redemption fee and available liquidity.

marketInfo.riskInvolved:
Potential risks and events which may lead to the yield going negative or depositors losing money: While mAPOLLO is intended to be an ‚Äúup-only‚Äù token in terms of exchange rate (similar to other Midas-issued tokens such as mEDGE and mMEV), several risks could still affect performance:

  • Underlying Strategy Risk: The reference portfolio comprises market-neutral, stablecoin-focused DeFi strategies. Unexpected market events, protocol failures, liquidity shortfalls, or mispricing could lead to reduced returns or losses in the underlying strategies.
  • Protocol Risk: Smart contract vulnerabilities, oracle failures, or integration issues with DeFi protocols used in the reference strategies could negatively affect performance.
  • Counterparty Risk: The appointed risk manager, Apollo Crypto, and any underlying protocol counterparties could fail to deliver expected execution or risk controls.
  • Regulatory/Legal Risk: Changes in applicable laws or enforcement actions could restrict certain strategies or limit product operations.
  • Operational Risk: Failures in execution, custody, or settlement infrastructure could cause delays or losses.

Although the token's exchange rate is designed to move upward as yield accrues in the reference portfolio, adverse events in any of the above categories could reduce or eliminate returns.

Senior USDe (srUSDe) is an over-collateralized, yield-bearing synthetic dollar backed by USDe, representing the senior risk tranche in Strata’s structure. It offers superior risk-adjusted yield by providing principal-protection and guaranteed minimum yield tied to the benchmark rate (Supply-weighted average of USDC/USDT lending rates on Aave Core) and uncapped upside exposure to sUSDe APY.

srUSDe always earns a share of the yield generated by the protocol on the pooled USDe collateral by staking USDe. Its yield has a floor equivalent to the benchmark rate ensuring uncapped upside exposure to sUSDe APY with minimum guaranteed yield. In extreme scenarios (jrUSDe TVL ~ 0, sUSDe APY < benchmark rate), srUSDe APY will be equivalent to the sUSDe APY.

marketInfo.assetDescription:
sUSDat is Saturn's yield-bearing vault token built on the ERC-4626 standard. It represents a user's share of a managed pool of digital credit exposure, where yield is generated from Saturn's STRC holdings and passed through to stakers automatically.

Insights page for Saturn here.

Updates as of 14 May: The sUSDat exchange rate has dropped below watermark rate due to STRC's ex-dividend event. Yield accrual for YT holders is temporarily paused and if STRC recovers to $100, the watermark is recaptured, yield accrual resumes, and your total earnings will be ultimately unaffected. Learn more about YT-sUSDat mechanics here.
marketInfo.riskInvolved:
sUSDat will face negative yield when:

  • Price Volatility: sUSDat tracks STRC’s live market price. Sharp STRC price drops (historically 3–6%) can outweigh dividend accrual, causing a net NAV decline.
  • STRC Peg Breaches: Stress, illiquidity, or BTC crashes can push STRC below its $99–$101 range.
  • Dividend Risk: Discretionary dividends may be deferred during BTC collapses, crashing STRC's market value which leads to net NAV decline.
  • Technical Risks: Oracle lags can cause abrupt NAV "step-downs," and large redemptions may trigger 1–5% market impact losses.

marketInfo.assetDescription:
Senior USDe (srUSDe) is an over-collateralized, yield-bearing synthetic dollar backed by USDe, representing the senior risk tranche in Strata’s structure. It offers superior risk-adjusted yield by providing principal-protection and guaranteed minimum yield tied to the benchmark rate (Supply-weighted average of USDC/USDT lending rates on Aave Core) and uncapped upside exposure to sUSDe APY.

srUSDe always earns a share of the yield generated by the protocol on the pooled USDe collateral by staking USDe. Its yield has a floor equivalent to the benchmark rate ensuring uncapped upside exposure to sUSDe APY with minimum guaranteed yield. In extreme scenarios (jrUSDe TVL ~ 0, sUSDe APY < benchmark rate), srUSDe APY will be equivalent to the sUSDe APY.
